prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down onto the object from above. Show no vertical outside faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game building sprite for a piece of camping gear in a frontier colony. Images 1 and 2 are our approved camp pieces from the same family, seen from directly above: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes.

Square canvas. The object fills about 60 percent of the canvas, one unit by one unit, centred, on a plain pure white background.

A hurricane lantern standing on the ground, seen from directly above: a round dark-green steel fuel base, a clear glass globe with a small warm yellow flame inside, a wire guard over the glass and a steel carry handle folded flat across the top.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, muted canvas and steel colours, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No text, letters, numbers, logos, people, animals, vehicles, food or loose goods. No ground beyond the object, no shadow outside it, no light rays or glow drawn around it, no perspective, no tilt.
